item.title: Garmin 5K Plan
item.description:
Oct 27, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 2.30 km
  • Duration: 14m 21s
  • Pace: 6:14 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 132 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

This running session was a bit non-trivial because Garmin proposed a plan to do a session where I ran in different stages. It was first trial so the expectation was to go shorter distance but I do not like to stop before two kilometers, which is my minimum.

I did it despite I have a morning meeting. So feeling a bit sleepy now. Overall quite relaxing run.

item.title: Sunday Morning Run
item.description:
Oct 25, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 2.07 km
  • Duration: 13m 39s
  • Pace: 6:36 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 153 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

Usually Sunday is the lazy day for me but I still went for running because nowadays during weekdays its tricky to find time especially when sun rises late.

Last night also the daylight saving is turned off (or on, its confusing). So everything is an hour late :p. Its funny for me always.

Anyway, feeling great about the run. I did only two kilometres today to avoid pushing two consecutive days.

item.title: Afternoon Run
item.description:
Sep 26, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 3.03 km
  • Duration: 20m 8s
  • Pace: 6:39 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 162 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

After finishing this run my lungs were happy despite of pushing through another kilometer than I usually go. However, for my legs it was a different story. My muscles were a bit overdoing, indicating that the strength is not there. So I need to figure out how to improve it. Nevertheless, I am feeling good about the run. It was easy and fun.
